name: EOC-Bench
description:
EOC-Bench : Can MLLMs Identify, Recall, and Forecast Objects in an Egocentric World?
	



 




	
	
	
		🔍 Overview
	

we introduce EOC-Bench, an innovative benchmark designed to systematically evaluate object-centric embodied cognition in dynamic egocentric scenarios.
Specially, EOC-Bench features 3,277 meticulously annotated QA pairs categorized into three temporal categories: Past, Present, and Future, covering 11 fine-grained evaluation  dimensions and 3 visual object referencing… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CircleRadon/EOC-Bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy (question-level; likely exact-match or classification accuracy for answers)
reputation: Research-oriented benchmark hosted on Hugging Face for evaluating egocentric object-centric cognition with modest community uptake.
